description: C1, as it happened: the registry reads the act from a resource's last segment, and an experiment id is a segment. A drafting turn proposing create_experiment_draft with experiment_id=exp-9/rollout once rolled exp-9 out under the draft tool's PRE_COMMIT grant, with no human. The id is now refused by validation as more than one segment, before the registry is touched: the turn is rejected, and exp-9 has no exposure event.
message: create_experiment_draft tenant=acme experiment_id=exp-9/rollout experiment_version=exp:abc123 hypothesis=bigger variant=100-percent-off
